title: Graph transpose of proper-first compact-support composition
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, W,V,Y Noetherian, q:W→V proper, v:V→Y separated quasi-compact etale with the chosen compactifications in the Lean signature, and c=(i,g) a compactification of f=qv. Form E:Rq*Dv!≅Di!Rg* from the inverse chosen proper comparison, inverse chosen etale comparison, compact-support compositor, congruence f=qv, and inverse comparison with c, in that order. For every K∈D(W_et,A), transpose E_K under Dv!⊣Dv* and follow it by exact proper base change for P=Z×_Y V. This equals the explicit transfer T_K of [def-pur-proper-clopen-graph-transfer]. There is no sheaf transformation tau, representative complex, or derived-functor unit in the assertion.

source.place: Tags 0F7B, 0F7I, 0F7J; graph support description in etale-cohomology.tex Tag 0F4L; SGA 4 XVII 6.2.11

proof.text: Factor q through the clopen graph t. Its proper comparison is right derivation of the inverse sheaf inclusion t!→t*. The compositor on this tower is open/proper interchange followed by proper composition.

Transpose the interchange under the etale extension/pullback adjunction. Exact proper base change turns it into the graph adjunct of the unit for c.i. Cancel the adjunction triangles and apply proper composition: the result is T_K.
Tower independence and the common-refinement cocycle identify this calculation with the chosen proper and etale comparisons and the comparison to c.

theorem properCompositor_graph_transpose
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {W V Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian W] [IsNoetherian V] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (q : W ⟶ V) [IsProper q]
    (v : V ⟶ Y) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [QuasiCompact v]
    [HasCompactification v] [HasCompactification (q ≫ v)]
    {f : W ⟶ Y} (hf : f = q ≫ v) [HasCompactification f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A W) :
    (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).homEquiv
        _ _ ((Functor.isoWhiskerRight (graphChosenProperComparison A q).symm
            (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory ≪≫
          Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q)
            (graphChosenEtaleComparison A v).symm ≪≫
          unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A q v ≪≫
          unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCongr A hf.symm ≪≫
          (rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A c).symm).hom.app K) ≫
      (exactDerivedBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (IsPullback.of_hasPullback c.g v).toCommSq).app
          ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) =
      ProperGraphTransfer.transfer q v hf c A K
